scope: DXF VIEWPORT ambient color name ordering and retained-string budget
finding: Reading group 63 or 421 cleared an already parsed group 431 name, making input order change the result. Commit cd700a3a fixed this previously; 995f25596 reintroduced the clearing.
change: Preserve the group 431 name and retained-byte lease when reading groups 63 or 421, while still clearing stale DWG-specific color metadata.

validation.before: Existing libdxfrw_dxf_viewport_ambient_color_order failed against the uncorrected code.
validation.after: Focused CTest cohort libdxfrw_dxf_viewport_ambient_color_order and libdxfrw_dxf_viewport_text_owner_budget passed 2/2.
validation.coverage: Existing test checks all six group permutations in ASCII and binary, write/readback, repeated groups, failed-read retry, and prior-name preservation. Owner-budget control checks replacement failure, live leases, and reset in both encodings. Updated its stale expectation to require retaining the previous name; registered it as a fast CTest.

limits: Local DXF transport and resource-budget evidence only; does not establish native rendering or broad format support. No drawing fixtures added.
